answer_1.quote: We propose LD-Agent-a modelagnostic Long-term Dialogue Agent framework consisting of three principal components: an event memory perception module, a persona extraction module, and response generation module
answer_1.outputs: Generated dialogue responses, event summaries, and extracted personas

answer_2.quote: For automatic evaluation, we use three widely used standard metrics: BLEU-N (BL-N) , ROUGE-L (R-L) , and METEOR (MET) to measure the quality of response generation

answer_4.quote: we employ 8 students to assist with the assessment ... Afterward, the interactions will be evaluated on three aspects: coherence, fluency and engagingness
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators assessed responses based on coherence, fluency, and engagingness
